high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "handemiyy," who has a verified badge next to their username. The post was made 3 hours prior to the screenshot being taken, as indicated by the timestamp at the top of the image. The individual is wearing a sleeveless black dress with a high neckline and a small slit on one side. They have dark hair tied back and are holding a smartphone in their right hand, using it to take the photo.
